core.headline: Freehold Two-Bedroom House in Sheerness – No Onward Chain
core.summary: A freehold mid-terrace house with two bedrooms, gas central heating and a rear yard, offered with no onward chain. The property requires modernisation and is for sale by Modern Method of Auction.
core.listing:
A freehold mid-terrace house with two bedrooms, one bathroom and a reception room, offered with no onward chain. The property requires modernisation and is located at Station Terrace in Sheerness.

The accommodation comprises a reception room, kitchen, two bedrooms and a bathroom. Gas central heating is installed.

Outside, there is a rear yard. On-street parking is available with no permit required.

Station Terrace is located in Sheerness.

This property is for sale by Modern Method of Auction. The buyer pays a non-refundable reservation fee of 4.2% of the purchase price (minimum £6,000) including VAT, in addition to the purchase price; 56-day reservation period. The guide price indicates the seller's minimum expectation; the reserve will be within 10% of the guide.

Guide Price £150,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band A (Swale Borough Council). EPC rating E. Construction: standard. Mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage. Gas central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: good outdoor coverage on major networks. On-street parking, no permit required. Building safety, restrictions, rights & easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield / mining: none known.
keyFeatures: Two bedrooms, one bathroom, one reception room
For sale by Modern Method of Auction
